title: 第019章 知耻而后勇第020章 他能考30分我就满足了
lines: 片刻后，苏恒就和王会、于飞煌、李亚琳等人一起站在高台上，听着郭展鹏激情的讲说……
“我宣布，大一全明星赛预选赛，第二场实践赛正式开始，我们灵木系最终还是要以实战为主。”
“虽然这里不能也没有时间，让学生们去把一株灵植从幼苗培育到成熟期，有那实力，早就是七八级的国宝级大宗师们了，所以咱们只能选一批受伤受损的灵植，让所有参赛者一起治疗了。”
“这一次，是19株受损程度一样的灵星果树，两个时辰为限，每人单独治疗，开始吧！”
“这一场之后，我们大一唯一一名灵木系最强，就可以代表649届全体师生，去竞争校队名额了，加油！”
随着郭展鹏的宣布，台下原本平整的泥土地里，突然浮现出19个小高台，每一个小高台体表都有阵法光泽闪烁，这是一种保护阵法，同样是放大型虚幻阵法。
每个进入高台的，施展术法拯救灵星果树的过程，都会被阵法放大十倍，以半透明的清晰影像呈现在所有观众和裁判眼中。
所有入内的参赛者，不得携带任何宝物，只能靠自己！
不然，出身富贵的拿一些各式各样的灵宝去施救，也就没了竞赛意义了。
万众关注下，在苏恒等人纷纷起身走向对应阵法高台时，看台上数千身影也再次爆发一群群欢呼。
“王会，王会必然第一！”
“于飞煌加油！”
“李亚琳，你好漂亮！”
所有参赛者，呼声最高最受观众们期待的，依旧是之前的前三学霸，他们的实力在人群心目中已经根深蒂固……
偶尔有一些妹子，也会因苏恒的外观喊他的名字，却眨眼被更大的呼喊潮流淹没。
终于进入了阵法小高台，苏恒运转木神功观察身前灵星果树，几个呼吸后就抽了一口冷气，坑啊，这灵星果树受到的损伤，简直复杂的变态。
灵星果树是一种提供星辰之力的灵植，正常阶段从幼苗到开花结果，果实成熟，需要十年周期，它的果实能凝结澎湃的星辰之力，化为一种强大的提升类丹药。
特别适合修炼火之力、光之力或锻炼体术的修炼者，说穿了这玩意储备的是太阳能精华，上个科技地球都知道太阳能可以储存起来，当做一种能源使用，大明帝国这修炼盛世的大牛们，也不傻。
太阳能和灵植，地球上的浓郁灵气结合，最终的灵星果炼制成丹药，一颗就让灵化境修炼者提升一重修为，不过服用过程，它的力量是狂暴燥乱的，你若能彻底炼化驯服，对自身也是一种磨练磨砺，通过这类灵丹提升的强者，不止修为不会比安稳修炼差，肉身也会一次次承受洗礼磨砺，变得更强大。
主要靠吸收太阳能生长繁衍的灵星果树，最主要条件就是生长环境足够炎热，阳光暴晒充足，水分、潮湿、寒冷等等是祂的大忌。
这不是说灵星果树不需要水分滋养，是需要特殊的灵水，蕴含火之力的煐水去缓慢灌溉滋养，孕育祂的灵土最好是珄土，催熟的话，最合适的肥料是蕴含大量微量元素昍的媭鳞肥，媭鳞肥产自一种特殊妖兽媭婋，此妖兽体型如小猪，背生双翼，吞日月华光生长，速度极快。
媭鳞肥是媭婋的汗液分泌物，媭鳞肥一旦融入灵星果树，会以极快速度被吸收，彻底融为一体，两者可以算本源之物了，一灵植一妖兽全是靠吸纳太阳能或者说日月精华生长进化。
content_en:
A moment later, Su Heng stood on the high platform with Wang Hui, Yu Feihuang, Li Yalin and others, listening to Guo Zhanpeng's passionate speech...
"I announce that the second practice match of the Freshman All-Star Game Qualifiers has officially begun. Our Spiritual Tree Department will ultimately focus on actual combat."
"Although we cannot and do not have the time here to let the students cultivate a spiritual plant from a seedling to a mature stage, with that kind of strength, they would already be national treasure-level masters of the seventh or eighth level, so we can only select a group of injured and damaged spiritual plants and let all the contestants treat them together."
"This time, there are 19 Lingxing fruit trees with the same degree of damage. They are limited to two hours. Each person will be treated individually. Let's start!"
"After this game, the only one of our freshmen with the strongest spiritual wood system can represent all the teachers and students of the 649th class to compete for a spot in the school team. Come on!"
Following Guo Zhanpeng's announcement, 19 small platforms suddenly appeared in the originally flat soil under the stage. The surface of each small platform had the luster of the formation flashing. This was a protective formation, and it was also an enlarged illusory formation.
The process of everyone who enters the high platform and performs magic to save the Lingxing Fruit Tree will be magnified ten times by the formation, and will be presented to the eyes of all spectators and referees as a translucent clear image.
All contestants who enter are not allowed to bring any treasures and can only rely on themselves!
Otherwise, there would be no point in the competition if someone from a wealthy family used various spiritual treasures to rescue people.
Under the attention of everyone, when Su Heng and others stood up and walked to the high platform corresponding to the formation, thousands of figures in the stands also burst into cheers again.
"Wang Hui, Wang Hui must be first!"
"Come on Yu Feihuang!"
"Li Yalin, you are so beautiful!"
…………
Of all the contestants, the ones with the highest voices and the most expectations from the audience are still the top three academic masters. Their strength has been deeply ingrained in the minds of the crowd...
Occasionally, some girls would call Su Heng's name because of his appearance, but in the blink of an eye they were drowned out by a larger wave of calls.
Finally entering the small platform of the formation, Su Heng used the wood-turning magic skill to observe the spiritual star fruit tree in front of him. After a few breaths, he took a breath of air-conditioning. Damn it, the damage to the spiritual star fruit tree was simply complicated and abnormal.
The Spirit Star Fruit Tree is a spiritual plant that provides the power of the stars. The normal stage is from seedling to flowering and fruiting. It takes ten years for the fruit to mature. Its fruit can condense the surging power of the stars and turn it into a powerful elixir of improvement.
It is especially suitable for practitioners who practice the power of fire, the power of light or exercise physical skills. To be honest, this thing stores the essence of solar energy. Everyone on the technological earth knows that solar energy can be stored and used as a kind of energy. The great masters of the Ming Empire, who are in the prosperous age of cultivation, are not stupid.
Solar energy, spiritual plants, and the rich spiritual energy on the earth are combined, and the final spiritual star fruit is refined into an elixir. One pill can allow a practitioner in the spiritual transformation realm to improve one level of cultivation. However, during the process of taking it, its power is violent and chaotic. If you can completely refine and tame it, it will also be a kind of training and tempering for yourself. A strong person who improves through this kind of spiritual pill will not only have a cultivation level that is no worse than a stable cultivation, but also the physical body will be baptized and tempered again and again, becoming stronger.
The Lingxing Fruit Tree, which mainly relies on absorbing solar energy to grow and reproduce, requires a hot enough growth environment and sufficient sunlight exposure. Water, humidity, cold, etc. are taboos for it.
This is not to say that the Spirit Star Fruit Tree does not need water to nourish it, but that it needs special spiritual water, ferrous water that contains the power of fire to slowly irrigate and nourish it. The spiritual soil for nurturing it is best to be fertilized soil. For ripening, the most suitable fertilizer is Yu scale fertilizer that contains a large amount of trace elements. Yu Scale fertilizer is produced from a special kind of monster Yu Ma. This monster is like a pig, has wings on its back, and grows extremely fast by swallowing the light of the sun and moon.
The scale fertilizer is Yumai's sweat secretion. Once the scale fertilizer is integrated into the spirit star fruit tree, it will be absorbed very quickly and completely integrated into one. The two can be regarded as origins. The spirit plant and the monster beast both grow and evolve by absorbing solar energy or the essence of the sun and the moon.
